One Infusion, Lasting Lipid Lowering? Editing the Liver’s DNA | Nature

In Vivo CRISPR Base Editing of ANGPTL3 for Durable Lipid Lowering
First author: Mizoguchi, Taiji
Last author: Khera, Amit V.
Journal: Nature
Published online: 2026-11-06
DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11233-9

A liver-targeted CRISPR base-editing approach kept a lipid-regulating protein strongly suppressed for three years after a single infusion in monkeys, while separate high-lipid animal models showed substantial cholesterol lowering. The findings support clinical investigation of a potential single-course treatment for people whose blood lipids remain high despite existing therapies.
